mapper.insert: INSERT INTO render_input_snapshots ( generation_job_id, media_plan_id, media_plan_revision, narration_request_id, narration_asset_id, narration_alignment_id, audio_storage_key, audio_size_bytes, audio_checksum, audio_duration_ms ) SELECT #{generationJobId}, #{mediaPlanId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{mediaPlanRevision}, narration.narration_request_id, narration.narration_asset_id, narration.narration_alignment_id, narration.storage_key, narration.size_bytes, narration.checksum, narration.duration_ms FROM media_plans mp LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT nr.id AS narration_request_id, na.id AS narration_asset_id, alignment.id AS narration_alignment_id, pa.storage_key, na.size_bytes, na.checksum, na.duration_ms FROM narration_requests nr JOIN narration_assets na ON na.narration_request_id = nr.id JOIN project_assets pa ON pa.id = na.project_asset_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT nal.id FROM narration_alignments nal WHERE nal.narration_asset_id = na.id AND nal.source_hash = nr.source_hash ORDER BY nal.created_at DESC, nal.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) alignment ON TRUE WHERE nr.project_id = #{projectId} AND nr.chapter_id = #{chapterId} AND nr.chapter_row_version = #{chapterRowVersion} AND nr.source_hash = #{sourceHash} AND pa.status = 'ACTIVE' AND pa.storage_key IS NOT NULL ORDER BY nr.created_at DESC, nr.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) narration ON TRUE WHERE mp.id = #{mediaPlanId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND mp.revision = #{mediaPlanRevision} AND mp.chapter_id = #{chapterId} AND mp.chapter_row_version = #{chapterRowVersion} AND mp.source_hash = #{sourceHash}

INSERT INTO render_input_snapshot_beats ( generation_job_id, scene_index, beat_index, visual_beat_id, media_generation_item_id, media_asset_id, duration_ms, camera_movement, storage_key, size_bytes, checksum ) SELECT #{generationJobId}, mbp.scene_index, mbp.beat_index, mbp.visual_beat_id, selected.media_generation_item_id, selected.media_asset_id, COALESCE( mbp.audio_duration_ms, CASE WHEN mbp.audio_start_ms IS NOT NULL AND mbp.audio_end_ms IS NOT NULL THEN mbp.audio_end_ms - mbp.audio_start_ms ELSE NULL END ), COALESCE(mbp.camera_movement, 'NONE'), ma.storage_key, ma.size_bytes, ma.sha256 FROM media_beat_plans mbp JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT mgi.id AS media_generation_item_id, mgi.media_asset_id FROM media_generation_items mgi WHERE mgi.media_plan_id = mbp.media_plan_id AND mgi.visual_beat_id = mbp.visual_beat_id AND mgi.execution_status = 'READY' AND mgi.media_asset_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mgi.attempt_number DESC, mgi.created_at DESC, mgi.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) selected ON TRUE JOIN media_assets ma ON ma.id = selected.media_asset_id WHERE mbp.media_plan_id = #{mediaPlanId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ma.asset_type = 'IMAGE' AND ma.status = 'READY' AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL AND ma.storage_key IS NOT NULL AND ma.size_bytes > 0 AND ma.sha256 IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_beat_plans WHERE media_plan_id = #{mediaPlanId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM render_input_snapshots WHERE generation_job_id = #{generationJobId} AND narration_request_id IS NOT NULL AND narration_asset_id IS NOT NULL AND audio_storage_key IS NOT NULL AND audio_checksum IS NOT NULL AND audio_duration_ms > 0 )
